tickets.summary: K-3401 non-drive-end bearing vibration rose from 2.1 to 4.6 mm/s in six weeks and remains upward, increasing trip risk on the single export train.
tickets.recommended_action: Specialist to diagnose bearing vibration; correct per findings and verify a stable trend below the alarm criterion. Confirm trip hazards and personnel exposure. Obtain source-required attention today. Recheck vibration and alarm status.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The non-drive-end bearing has a strong, unplateaued vibration increase with growing 1x content, supporting advanced progression but not confirmed function loss.

impact_of_failure.rationale: A trip of this single train has no spare or workaround and would send the platform to recycle, cutting production within an hour.

tickets.summary: FW-8102 failed its first test start, then started after 8 seconds; batteries were 22.8 V at rest, and rated discharge pressure was achieved once running.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect batteries/start air; correct findings under fire-protection engineer disposition; prove first-attempt start and rated delivery. Check impairment deviation record. Load-test batteries and check start air. Repeat first-attempt start test. Test FW-8101 pressure and flow.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: A required start-on-demand function failed during the weekly function test. The delayed successful retry and normal running preserve delivery evidence but do not erase the initial functional failure.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of this safety-critical firewater pump creates severe major-accident protection exposure. FW-8101 is the named redundant partner, but its later test showed 9.2 barg versus 11 barg design with flow unmeasured, so capable redundancy cannot be credited.

tickets.summary: PL-1002 wall thickness is 6.2 mm versus 7.4 mm minimum at window 2 near the low-point drain, with saturated insulation and heavy scaling on a live full-pressure hydrocarbon line.
tickets.recommended_action: Integrity engineer to extend CUI/UT survey, assess fitness, specify repair if needed, and verify pressure-boundary acceptance. Check exposure and release scenario. Confirm current status and disposition. Extend CUI/UT survey around the defect.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of this non-redundant production flowline could release hydrocarbons at full wellhead pressure, creating severe personnel and process exposure.

tickets.summary: Main-hoist rope has 6 broken wires per lay versus a 10-wire discard criterion at the maximum-radius drum section; poor lubrication may accelerate degradation.
tickets.recommended_action: Have an authorized lifting competent person inspect and lubricate the rope, disposition findings, and verify the discard criterion. Check lift loads, routes and personnel exposure. Reinspect rope and function-test hoist.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Six broken wires remain below the 10-wire discard criterion, providing supported margin, but poor lubrication at the same section is an active degradation mechanism.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Main-hoist rope failure on a nonredundant pedestal crane presents credible lifting and personnel exposure and would stop supply-boat offloads, causing logistics problems within days.

tickets.summary: P-3305 has tripped three times this month, causing intermittent wellhead-manifold inhibitor injection for about ten days; the diaphragm is only suspected.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect diaphragm and discharge system; repair per findings, obtain process/integrity disposition, and verify sustained inhibitor injection. Assess downstream integrity and exposure. Check recorded deviation status. Inspect diaphragm and discharge system.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Three trips in one month and intermittent injection for around ten days are direct evidence of recurrent required-function interruption; the suspected diaphragm cause remains unconfirmed.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of the sole corrosion-inhibitor pump can starve downstream carbon steel, initiating corrosion within weeks with delayed integrity consequences; production does not stop immediately.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of the sole temporary-refuge pressurisation function can expose mustering personnel to hydrocarbons during a gas release; no redundancy is identified.

tickets.summary: Firewater pump A started but stabilised at 9.2 barg versus 11 barg design pressure; flow was unmeasured, so required firewater delivery capability is suspected degraded.
tickets.recommended_action: Fire-protection engineer to inspect test-line valves and pump; repair per findings and retest pressure and flow to approved criteria. Check impairment deviation record. Function-test FW-8102 capability. Test pressure and flow to criteria.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Below-design running pressure is a meaningful delivery-capability precursor, but normal engine parameters, successful starting, unmeasured flow and unspecified acceptance criteria do not establish failed required function.
